The bug report indicates that there is an issue with the rendering of vector contexts in tile layers when the view is rotated close to 90 and 270 degrees. This results in inconsistencies in stroke width, text scale, and geometry precision. The problem seems to stem from how the rendering logic handles transformations and tile drawing when the rotation is applied.

1. `src/ol/layer/Tile.js`

The `CanvasTileLayerRenderer` class in `src/ol/renderer/canvas/TileLayer.js` is particularly important because it handles the rendering logic for tile layers, including the transformations applied during rendering.
